project.name: Synthetic Lab Platform
project.description: A fictional project timeline used to demonstrate decision drift.

decisions.title: Use SQLite for experiment metadata
decisions.choice: Store experiment metadata in a local SQLite database.
decisions.rationale: The prototype had one writer, under 100 MB of metadata, and no cloud synchronization requirement.

assumptions.statement: Only one process writes experiment metadata at a time.
Metadata remains below 1 GB during the prototype phase.

alternatives.label: Move metadata to PostgreSQL
alternatives.rejected_because: Operational overhead was unnecessary for a single-user prototype.

rules.message: The local storage choice assumed a single writer.
Metadata reached the review threshold recorded in the original decision.

next_actions: Run a 30-minute concurrent-write benchmark on the current workload.
Compare migration cost and operational burden before changing storage.

decisions.title: Use a compact model for triage
decisions.choice: Use a compact model for first-pass issue triage.
decisions.rationale: The larger model exceeded the project's cost ceiling in February.

assumptions.statement: A larger model costs at least $2 per million input tokens.

alternatives.label: Re-evaluate a larger model for difficult cases
alternatives.rejected_because: It exceeded the recorded input-token cost ceiling.

rules.message: The cost reason for rejecting a larger model may no longer hold.

next_actions: Benchmark the compact and larger model on the same 100 synthetic issues.

decisions.title: Exclude recovery time from the dashboard
decisions.choice: Omit recovery time because the initial pilot found high measurement noise.
decisions.rationale: The metric did not separate synthetic groups in the first pilot.

assumptions.statement: Recovery time has no useful predictive value under the revised protocol.

alternatives.label: Reintroduce recovery time with repeated measurements
alternatives.rejected_because: The first pilot showed high noise and no separation.

rules.message: New evidence directly challenges the premise used to omit the metric.
Reliability may now be high enough to retest predictive value.

next_actions: Read the cited method section before treating the external result as transferable.
Run a blinded repeated-measurement reliability pilot.
